title: Rock Candy
body:
Description

The Rock Candy is a holiday rock that spawns during the 2025 Christmas Event, inside Mike's Mines and near the Lost Woods1. As they are a seasonal rock, they may be sold for the seasonal currency, Snowflakes (❄️). They do not sell for cash.

The Rock Candy appears in two variants: Purple Rock Candy and Yellow Rock Candy. The variants are identical in functionality, with the latter being slightly more expensive.

Rock Candy is also transparent in all forms, with the transparency decreasing as the rock is processed. It is the most transparent when Raw, and the least transparent when Forged. This transparency also carries over to blueprints.

Unlike other nodes, Rock Candy may also form in a tall cluster of interlocking cubes, rather than a standard cluster, making it easier to spot in darkness.

Rock Candy is currently unobtainable naturally, and may only be obtained by trading with another player, or, another Christmas event occurs, re-adding Rock Candy nodes.

Variants

Yellow Rock Candy

Yellow Rock Candy is the yellow-coloured variant of Rock Candy. It is worth slightly more per stud than its purple counterpart.

Purple Rock Candy

Purple Rock Candy is the purple-coloured variant of Rock Candy. It is worth slightly less per stud than its yellow counterpart.

Notes

  • It is recommended to sell the candy raw as the increase in price when forged is minimal and the process is simpler and quicker.
  • Ores will not spawn in the Rock Candy.
  • A full semi-truck (Freyliner Transporter) of Raw Yellow Rock Candy sells for about $60,000 ❄️.2
  • Due to the fact the Rock Candy is transparent, a Grabby/Grabbiest Grabber's field can clip through, creating a transparent region.
